extDescription.message: Bionic-style reading on every site, plus reader view, a focus ruler, readable fonts and page tints.

cmdToggleSite.message: Turn on/off on the current site

fixationHint.message: Share of the letters at the start of each word that are made bold.

fadeHint.message: Make the rest of each word lighter so the bold start stands out more. In text that is already bold (headings) the start gets heavier and the rest slightly lighter automatically.

saccadeHint.message: Emphasise every word, or only some of them for a lighter look.

minWordLengthHint.message: Leave short words (prepositions, articles) without emphasis.

skipCodeHint.message: Don't change text inside code blocks, code editors and terminals.

fontHint.message: OpenDyslexic is made for readers with dyslexia; Andika has clear letterforms that are hard to confuse. Both cover Cyrillic. Atkinson Hyperlegible and Lexend have Latin letters only — Cyrillic is shown in PT Sans.

previewText.message: Bionic reading guides your eyes through the text: the bold start of each word is enough for the brain to recognise it, so reading feels lighter and focus drifts less.

previewTextLong.message:
Bionic reading guides your eyes through the text: the bold start of each word is enough for the brain to recognise it, so reading feels lighter and focus drifts less.

Try different settings and see what is comfortable for you. A larger bold part gives more support; a lighter rest of the word adds contrast.

noticeRestricted.message: Chrome doesn't allow extensions on this page.

noticeFileAccess.message: To use it on local files, enable “Allow access to file URLs” for ADHD Reader in chrome://extensions.

noticePdf.message: This PDF is open in the browser’s own viewer, which extensions can’t change. Open it in ADHD Reader to read it with all modes.

noticeReload.message: Reload the page to activate ADHD Reader here.

noticeReaderUnavailable.message: Reader view can't be opened on this page.

optionsSubtitle.message: Bionic reading, focus and comfortable text on every website

enabledHint.message: Main switch for everything the extension does on pages. Reader view keeps working on sites where it's off.

sitesHintAll.message: Sites where it's off, one per line. A domain also covers its subdomains: example.com turns it off on news.example.com too.

sitesHintOnly.message: Sites where it's on, one per line. A domain also covers its subdomains.

lookHint.message: Changes the font and spacing of text on pages and tints the screen. Bigger spacing can make some site layouts wrap differently.

focusHint.message: Keeps the line or paragraph under the mouse bright and darkens the rest of the screen.

readerHint.message: Shows just the article text — no ads, menus or sidebars — with bionic emphasis, your font, a progress bar and the time left. Open it from the popup, the context menu or with the shortcut; Esc closes it.

readerNotFound.message: Couldn't find the main text on this page.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings, including the site lists?

aboutText.message: Settings are synced through your Chrome profile.

fontGroupLatin.message: Latin only (Cyrillic shown in PT Sans)

viewerSubtitle.message: PDF, EPUB, FB2 and TXT with bionic reading, your fonts and focus modes

viewerDropHint.message: PDF, EPUB, FB2 (also .fb2.zip) or TXT. The file is opened right here and is not uploaded anywhere.

viewerPickAgain.message: Choose “$NAME$” again: files from your computer can’t be reopened automatically.

viewerUnsupported.message: This file format is not supported. Open a PDF, EPUB, FB2 or TXT file.

viewerBroken.message: The file could not be read: it may be damaged.

viewerModeHint.message: Switch between text for reading and the original pages

viewerScanned.message: This PDF looks like a scan: it has almost no text, so it is shown as pages. Bionic reading and fonts need real text.

openFileTitle.message: Read a PDF, EPUB, FB2 or TXT file from your computer

documentsHint.message: PDF, EPUB, FB2 and TXT open in the extension’s own viewer, where everything works: bionic reading, fonts, spacing, tint and focus. It remembers where you stopped.

openDocumentsLabel.message: Open PDF links in ADHD Reader

openDocumentsHint.message: Instead of Chrome’s PDF viewer, which extensions can’t change. The ↗ button in the viewer shows the original.
